$comment: Advisories `pnpm audit:check` (scripts/audit.ts) accepts. One entry per advisory and package, with why it does not apply here and a date (at most 180 days ahead) after which it must be reviewed again. An expired entry, or one that no longer matches an advisory, fails the check.

advisories.reason: esbuild 0.18.20 comes only through drizzle-kit 0.31 (@esbuild-kit/esm-loader), a CLI for pnpm db:generate and the drift checks that the server bundle does not contain. The advisory is about esbuild's development server (`esbuild --serve`), which drizzle-kit never starts. Moderate. drizzle-kit 1.0 drops @esbuild-kit (ADR 0005 keeps 0.x for now).
